verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google spend is producing zero results.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 130 leads at a cost of $19.85 per lead — every single one came from Meta. Google Ads consumed $1,240 of your budget over the same window and produced zero leads, which is the central issue this period. On top of that, lead volume dropped 50% in the most recent week while Meta spend held steady, meaning cost per lead rose 29% week-over-week as creative performance softened. Google spend is being pulled back while offline conversion tracking is built out — once that is live, Google campaigns can be re-trained on real signals rather than running blind. New ad creative and dedicated landing pages are due by end of August, which should stabilise Meta's cost per lead heading into September.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
spent on Google Ads this period with zero leads returned
rise in cost per lead over the last 7 days as weekly lead volume halved

watch_item.issue: Lead volume fell sharply in the final days of this period — 2 leads in the last 3 days versus 18 in the 3 days prior — pointing to creative fatigue on Meta.
watch_item.fix: A new UGC creative batch and senior-avatar ads are being finalised this month to refresh the Meta feed before the next billing cycle.
